source.paper: unknown US daily, Valentine's personals section

summary: A once-a-year Valentine 'Love Lines' section: a row of outlined hearts, VALENTINE in giant stippled black letters wrapped by a ribbon banner, then columns mixing short bold-lead love notes with boxed centred messages in heavy slab names and italic sign-offs.

frame.masthead: Illustrated banner: outline hearts, stippled-texture display letters, a ribbon reading LOVE LINES · LOVE LINES.

headers.notes: Wavy ribbon of light geometric sans caps with middots, weaving through the display letters.

units.example: KATHY, YOU'RE the greatest Wife and Mom us guys could ever want...
units.notes: Name and first words in bold caps; very small condensed sans body.

units.example: JOYCE / Being without you has to be the most painful time of my life... / GARY B.
units.notes: Name in bold slab caps, message in large roman serif, sign-off in italic caps. Box sizes vary by price.

units.example: YOU'RE NOT A HOUSE-PAINTER, IT'S TRUE...
units.notes: Whole message in serif caps, centred.

type.look: Ultra-heavy sans with a stippled/sponge texture fill
Roman serif for boxed messages, italic for sign-offs
Tiny condensed sans for liner notes

notes: Seasonal sections are a natural generator mode: swap the banner and sign-off vocabulary (Valentine, Christmas greetings, graduation).
